files_summary.directions_ny_chicago.json: Directions response from New York to Chicago (driving mode). Contains route summary, legs with start/end addresses, distance, duration, step‑by‑step instructions, warnings and overview polyline.
files_summary.directions_chicago_santamonica.json: Directions response from Chicago to Santa Monica (driving mode). Includes route summary, leg details, distance, duration, a sample step, and warnings about tolls and time zones.
files_summary.distance_matrix.json: Distance Matrix response for three origins (Washington DC, New York, Los Angeles) to two destinations (San Francisco, Chicago). Provides distance and duration for each origin‑destination pair and overall status.
files_summary.elevation_multi.json: Elevation response for three locations: Denver, CO; Mt. Everest, Nepal; and Death Valley, CA. Each entry contains elevation in meters, latitude/longitude, and resolution.
files_summary.geocode_examples.json: Geocoding response for two addresses – the Googleplex (1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA) and 10 Downing St, London. Includes address components, formatted address, geometry (location, viewport), place IDs and result types.
files_summary.reverse_geocode_examples.json: Reverse‑geocoding response for two coordinate sets – Brooklyn, NY and Westminster, London. Returns formatted address, address components, geometry (location and viewport) and place IDs.
files_summary.place_details_google_sydney.json: Place Details response for Google Sydney (place_id ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4). Provides full address components, formatted address, phone number, geometry, name, opening hours, rating, a sample review and place types.
files_summary.place_details_eiffel_tower.json: Place Details response for the Eiffel Tower (place_id ChIJA5B6KPJf5kcRRlJ8mF02HPY). Includes address components, formatted address, international phone, geometry, name, opening hours, rating, multiple reviews and place types.
files_summary.search_places_coffee_ny.json: Places Search response for coffee shops near Times Square, NY. Lists several coffee venues with place IDs, names, geometry (lat/lng), vicinity, rating, total user ratings and place types.
files_summary.search_places_hotels_paris.json: Places Search response for hotels in Paris. Contains several hotel entries with place IDs, names, geometry (lat/lng), vicinity, rating, total user ratings and place types.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: load_directions_ny_chicago
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Directions API sample response for a driving route from New York, NY to Chicago, IL. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded response payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because no inputs are supported for selecting or customizing the route.

tool_schemas.name: load_directions_chicago_santamonica
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Directions API sample response for a driving route from Chicago, IL to Santa Monica, CA. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded response payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because no inputs are supported for selecting or customizing the route.

tool_schemas.name: load_distance_matrix
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Distance Matrix API sample response for origins Washington, DC; New York, NY; and Los Angeles, CA to destinations San Francisco, CA and Chicago, IL. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded matrix response. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the origin/destination set is fixed and cannot be overridden.

tool_schemas.name: load_elevation_multi
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Elevation API sample response for Denver, CO; Mt. Everest, Nepal; and Death Valley, CA. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded elevation results. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the locations are fixed and no custom query is supported.

tool_schemas.name: load_geocode_examples
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns stored Google Maps Geocoding API sample responses for the Googleplex address and 10 Downing Street, London. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded geocoding results. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the addresses are fixed and cannot be changed.

tool_schemas.name: load_reverse_geocode_examples
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns stored Google Maps Reverse Geocoding API sample responses for coordinates in Brooklyn, NY and Westminster, London. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded reverse-geocoding results. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the coordinates are fixed and no alternative points can be requested.

tool_schemas.name: load_place_details_google_sydney
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Place Details API sample response for Google Sydney (place_id ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4). This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded place details payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the place_id and requested fields are fixed in this sample.

tool_schemas.name: load_place_details_eiffel_tower
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Place Details API sample response for the Eiffel Tower (place_id ChIJA5B6KPJf5kcRRlJ8mF02HPY). This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded place details payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the place_id and requested fields are fixed in this sample.

tool_schemas.name: load_search_places_coffee_ny
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Places Search API sample response for coffee shops near Times Square, New York. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded search results payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the query and location bias are fixed and not configurable.

tool_schemas.name: load_search_places_hotels_paris
tool_schemas.description: Loads and returns a stored Google Maps Places Search API sample response for hotels in Paris. This endpoint takes no parameters and always returns the same pre-recorded search results payload. It refuses requests that include any parameters or body content, because the query and search area are fixed and not configurable.

metadata.name: AtlasRoute Response Vault
metadata.description: Stores and serves cached mapping API responses for directions, distance matrices, elevation, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and place search/details so teams can reliably retrieve consistent location-data payloads on demand.
